verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, documented remote MCP server (mcp.ramp.com/mcp), plus a developer docs MCP and Ramp Data MCP, with live probes confirming OAuth-gated JSON-RPC endpoints, scopes, and admin controls for role-based access. Docs and support articles walk through connecting assistants like Claude/ChatGPT and taking real actions (query data, lock cards, approve requests). Missing for 10: no independent third-party review of real-world MCP usage beyond Ramp's own docs/support pages.
